title: Restored Heart
story:
A boy accidentally broke a valuable item in his home.

Fear filled his heart.

He tried to hide it.

He avoided the place where it happened.

But the guilt stayed with him.

It followed him wherever he went.

Finally, he could not carry it anymore.

He went to his father and said,

“I did something wrong.”

He expected anger.

He expected punishment.

But instead, his father listened quietly.

Then he forgave him.

He even helped him fix what was broken.

In that moment, the boy felt free.

The burden was gone.

In our lives, we often try to hide our mistakes.

We carry guilt and shame.

But God invites us to come to Him honestly.

When we confess, He forgives.

Not partially.

Completely.

And He cleanses our hearts.

Giving us a fresh start.
life_lesson:
Confession brings freedom.

When you come to God honestly, He forgives you and restores your heart completely.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your faithfulness and forgiveness.

Help me to come to You with an honest heart.

Give me the courage to confess my sins.

Cleanse me and make me new.

Teach me to walk in Your ways each day.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there something you are trying to hide from God?

What is stopping you from confessing it?

How would your life change if you received His full forgiveness today?
verse:
If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just.
He will forgive us our sins.
And purify us from all unrighteousness.
